title: Rapid Fire - Round 1
description: One-line prompts. Anyone can answer, nobody has to be clever.
attribution: Written for Mshikaki by the Innovations team

items.prompt: Name three things you would grab if the office caught fire.
Name three apps you have already opened today.
Name three Kenyan brands you would defend in an argument.
Name three things in your pockets or bag right now.
Name three words your friends would use to describe you.
Name three songs for a Nairobi-to-Mombasa road trip.
Name three Kenyan roads you would avoid at 5pm.
Name three things you would find in an ICT office at 8am.
Name three ways to spend a Sunday in Nairobi.
Name three Kenyan foods you can actually cook.
Name three things you would tell your 18-year-old self.
Name three things on your desk that are not work-related.
Name three phone brands people argue about.
Name three things that always run late in Kenya.
Name three chores you would happily pay someone to do.
Name three things you learned from a YouTube video.
Name three sounds you hear from your office window.
